description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_CacheModify, which contains methods for handling cache validation and modification checks within the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_CacheModify
classes.description: A class providing methods to check and modify cache states during template rendering in Smarty.

methods.name: cacheModifiedCheck
methods.description: Checks whether the cache has been modified based on HTTP headers and cache timestamps, and sends appropriate headers or outputs content.
